attacksAttemptedAndFailed.detail: CLAUDE-V7-A-1's own suggestion was that a later successor should either fold the nine or record once why the class is carried indefinitely, so that 'not folded this successor' stops being the standing answer. This draft answers it with the standing form - it travels as honesty work - which is arguably the very pattern the advisory names. I considered whether that makes item 3 inadequate and concluded it does not, on two grounds. First, the obligation my advisory described falls on a successor contract, not on a decision that merely records the current one; D-111 edits no contract and could not fold anything without retargeting frozen v7 bytes. Second, I graded the advisory non-blocking in my own frozen verdict and wrote there that I was noting it for consistency and not as a bar. Escalating it now, in review of the decision that dispositions it, would be self-dealing and would let one reviewer convert a self-authored advisory into a veto.
